latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the "influencer-plan" skill, designed to help startups launch effective influencer and creator partnerships.

- Guides users through a structured discovery process to understand their goals, audience, and budget.
- Provides tailored strategy covering creator identification, partnership models, outreach, campaign execution, and measurement.
- Includes practical templates, negotiation tips, and key metrics for measuring ROI.
- Offers a clear action plan to launch creator partnerships.
- Curates further reading resources for deeper learning on influencer marketing.
